title: Array Sum
code: function sum(arr) { if(!Array.isArray(arr)) return 0; return arr.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); }

title: Fibonacci Recursive
code: function fib(n) { if(n<=1) return n; return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2); }

title: String Reverse
code: function reverseStr(str) { if(typeof str !== 'string') return ''; return str.split('').reverse().join(''); }

title: Find Max
code: function findMax(arr) { if(!arr || !arr.length) return null; return Math.max(...arr); }

title: Bubble Sort
code: function sortArr(arr) { for(let i=0; i<arr.length; i++) { for(let j=0; j<arr.length; j++) { if(arr[i] < arr[j]) { let t=arr[i]; arr[i]=arr[j]; arr[j]=t; } } } return arr; }

title: Prime Check
code: function isPrime(n) { if(n <= 1) return false; for(let i=2; i<=Math.sqrt(n); i++) { if(n%i===0) return false; } return true; }

title: Palindrome Check
code: function isPalindrome(str) { const clean = str.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); return clean === clean.split('').reverse().join(''); }

title: Factorial Iterative
code: function factorial(n) { if(n<0) return null; let res=1; for(let i=2; i<=n; i++) res*=i; return res; }

title: Binary Search
code: function binarySearch(arr, target) { let l=0, r=arr.length-1; while(l<=r) { const m=Math.floor((l+r)/2); if(arr[m]===target) return m; if(arr[m]<target) l=m+1; else r=m-1; } return -1; }

title: Capitalize Words
code: function capitalize(str) { return str.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' '); }
